unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U09: Apply good-faith protection, company-offence responsibility and jurisdiction carefully

facts.statement: Section32 good-faith authorised acts protection;33 company and responsible persons, lack-knowledge/diligence defence and consent/connivance/neglect route, firm/partner included.34 civil bar for matters Tribunal empowered;35 inconsistency override;36 limitation;37 additional remedies.

payload.title: Strong powers retain legal boundaries
payload.core_explanation_md:
Good-faith protection under section 32 concerns the protected acts and persons; it is not a licence to ignore the Act. Section33 separately addresses company offences and responsible persons, including the stated lack-of-knowledge or due-diligence defence and the consent/connivance/neglect route. A job title alone does not replace analysis of the statutory responsibility and evidence.

Section34 bars civil-court intervention in the matters assigned to the Tribunal framework; it should not be expanded into a claim that no judicial remedy can ever exist. Sections35 and37 must also be read together: overriding inconsistent law does not mean every other law disappears. Section36 preserves limitation checks, including the appropriate claim and triggering facts.

self_check.prompt_text: Does good-faith protection prove every collection act was lawful?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The authorised scope, conduct and statutory requirements still need examination.

payload.stem_md: A recovery officer argues that good-faith protection removes the need to check notices or limitation. What is the sound response?

options.text_md: Agree because intention alone overrides every procedural requirement
options.explanation_md: The protection is not an unrestricted substitute for compliance.

options.text_md: Assume every officer is personally liable without evidence
options.explanation_md: Liability also needs the applicable statutory conditions.

options.text_md: Ignore limitation whenever collateral is valuable
options.explanation_md: Asset value does not itself preserve an expired claim.

options.text_md: Examine the protected scope and compliance facts separately
options.explanation_md: Protection, statutory authority and proper process are distinct questions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Protection, statutory authority and proper process are distinct questions.

payload.stem_md: A company officer produces evidence of lack of knowledge and due diligence to prevent the offence. How should the section 33 analysis treat it?

options.text_md: Disregard it because every employee is automatically guilty
options.explanation_md: The statutory responsibility and defence provisions require analysis.

options.text_md: Assess it against the stated statutory defence and any consent/connivance/neglect evidence
options.explanation_md: Neither automatic conviction nor automatic exoneration follows without applying the tests.

options.text_md: Treat it as proof the debt was discharged
options.explanation_md: Offence responsibility and repayment are unrelated determinations.

options.text_md: Replace the company case with a new loan application
options.explanation_md: That does not address the statutory responsibility question.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Neither automatic conviction nor automatic exoneration follows without applying the tests.
